correctness.rationale: For any finite tree, K equals occupied vertices minus occupied edges; exact incident-support joint-cumulant classification yields the displayed polynomial with coefficients n,m,H,J,P4. All edge configurations of size at most 3 are handled, and higher-vertex counts do not enter. The variance H classification exhausts unlabeled trees on at most six vertices, proving minimality; a direct four-occupied-subset count yields the full witness PGF gap. The independent standard-library checker enumerates all 2..6-vertex tree classes, all survival subsets at four exact rational probabilities, and both witness tables. Infinite assertions rely on the analytic cumulant proof, not these finite checks.

value.rationale: Habitat fragmentation studies count disconnected occupied patches under site survival. The precise question is what structural information enters uncertainty beyond mean/variance; an all-tree formula reveals excess-degree alignment through four-site paths as the first new quantity, while an exact unique six-patch pair proves the smallest genuine identifiability failure of those first two moments. This is a motivated structural boundary and not an arbitrary parameter slice or novelty solely from finite enumeration.
